reason: Going from paying my cousin $600 once a year to paying a stranger $2,400 a year is a huge jump, so knowing her name is Carla, that there's no contract, and that she'll waive the fee if she misses her deadline makes Document B feel much safer. I also appreciate that she invited me to talk about what I'm doing for my books right now on the call, since I don't actually want to fire my cousin at tax time.
